quests.title: Marked Ones
quests.story: Gold-named zombies carry gifts: Swift, Vampiric, Bomber and worse. Take this sigil: use it in a swamp to call the Plague Mother.

quests.title: Bigger Than the Rest
quests.story: Old powers wait out there: a brute in the Nether, a lich in the cold, a warden in the hills. A Zombie Warlord counts too. Boss Sigils (see JEI) call a boss in its own land. Find one and end it.
